scenes.text: Most small businesses don't need more A-I. They need one broken process fixed.
Every week, I take one kind of business. A roofer. A dental office. A salon. And I find where customers fall through the cracks.
You'll see the broken flow, the fix, and where a person still needs to step in.
No hype. If something isn't worth automating, I'll tell you.
This is, Can I Automate This Business? Follow, and comment which business I should fix next.
